## New

- **Thinking next to the model.** The chat input has a Thinking menu for the current mode when the selected model can think. Default, Off, Low, Medium and High are that mode's reasoning effort, the same setting as **Settings > Models > Which model does what**, and choosing one saves it to `config.yaml`. A model that does not think hides the menu.

## Behaviour changes

- A reasoning effort saved on the current mode is what the next chat request sends, unless you have clicked the reasoning toggle for that model. Clicking the toggle still overrides the level.
